display.title: Vov Tishrei: The Yahrzeit of the Shpoler Zeide
display.summary_short: A short introduction for Vov Tishrei, the yahrzeit of the Shpoler Zeide, and how his descendants around the world mark the day.
display.summary_long: A short clip from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, recorded a few days after Rosh Hashanah. Uncle Yossi wishes everyone a good and sweet year and explains that the sixth day of Tishrei, Vov Tishrei, is the yahrzeit of the great tzaddik Rabbi Aryeh Leib of Shpola, known as the Shpoler Zeide. All over the world his descendants gather on this day to retell his stories and make good resolutions to follow his noble character and pious deeds. More and more families discover each year that they too descend from him. The clip ends by promising to explain later in the program how listeners can find out whether they are his descendants; that part is not included.
display.lesson: On a tzaddik's yahrzeit we retell his stories and resolve to follow his example.
